RentRollOutputNodes.description:
Standard output node ids for a rent roll.

The richer rent-roll helper also emits fixed transparency nodes
`vacancy_loss_physical` and `renewal_prob_loss` in addition to these
configurable aggregate outputs.

rent_effective_node.description: Total effective rent (EGI rent component): `rent_pgi - free_rent - vacancy_loss`.

rent_pgi_node.description: Total contractual rent (PGI) from all leases.

vacancy_loss_node.description: Total vacancy loss (includes occupancy and renewal probability effects).

description: Standard node ids for a full property operating statement template.

ncf_node.description: Net cash flow (NCF) node id: `noi - capex_total`.

opex_total_node.description: Total operating expenses node id (includes management fee if enabled).

rent_roll.description: Rent roll output nodes (PGI/free rent/vacancy/effective rent).
